title: NBFCs must balance growth, governance and technology to build sustainable lending models: NBFC Honchos
summary: NBFCs must align lending growth with funding costs, asset quality and risk appetite as regulatory scrutiny and competition intensify, industry leaders said at the ETBFSI NBFC Leaders’ Retreat 2026. Technology-led efficiency, digital MSME lending and affordable housing emerged as key opportunities for sustainable expansion.
